notes.title: 0.9.5 EOS Hotfix
notes.content: Quick patch to fix an error that prevents ESO from connecting online.

notes.title: Head 2 Head 0.8.3 EA
notes.content:
High flying Grappler B. Swole has got new moves! Come check him out.

- Added unique strike and jump moves for B.Swole
- Modified the difficulty curve in survival mode
- Modified the Damage multiplier for the CPU in survival mode.
- Added new Augment "Rarity up" to improve rare chances on roguelike stat drops in survival mode.

notes.title: HEAD 2 HEAD 0.8.0 UPDATE
notes.content:
MAJOR UPDATE

Head 2 Head's Survival mode gets a huge Roguelike update!

In Survival mode, you get 3 randomly rolled stat buffs of different rarities after each battle. You get 5 after each boss fight. These buffs can help you reach higher and higher into the survival tower. If you come across some weak buffs that are not helpful, you can spend Skull Tokens to reroll your buff spread.

WAY MORE content and updates coming to Head 2 Head. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Head 2 Head: Update 0.4.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40566790/d392763bd4c24fe0028f2b2762cc51361da215c7.png
Update to 0.4.1

Survival:
+1 Skull gained in Survival for a Perfect Round.
+1 Skull gained in Survival for every 10 completed rounds.

Versus:
+1 Skull gained for every round won (By any player).
+1 Skull gained for every Perfect Round.

Other:
+30 Skulls on first boot up. New players will have 0 skulls to roll with as soon as they start the game for the first time.
+ Arrows on Head Case to indicate scrolling edges.

notes.content:

notes.title: Head 2 Head: 0.3a Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed Savegame error that causes crashed when selecting characters.
Added a new Secret code input " Up Up Down Down Up Up Up Up" for 200 free skulls.

notes.title: Head 2 Head: 0.3
notes.content:
Update 0.3:

Reduced cost of rolling a single and multi heads from 20 to 10 each.
Obtained heads are now sorted in the headcase,
New Effects for some Legendary Heads.
New heads added to Headcase and Roll odds.
Fixed issue with exe not running due to false positive.

notes.title: Head 2 Head: Update 0.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40566790/49945c5e1b6230923b92c138b4d5c221bf6cc542.png
New Head 2 Head update!

New additions and various improvements added to User Experience and gameplay.

*More settings in options
*Head Selection for game modes
*Color Selection for Game Modes
*Rolling for heads using Skull Tokens obtained in game modes
*Viewing Heads in the Head Case
*Entering Secret codes to unlock special heads
